name: The Already-Waited
pitch: You did all your waiting as a child at a ferry landing: your heart demon pays a long art's cooldown and it fires now, and afterwards you go back and stand one season for every second you refused.

new.name: Already Waited
new.effect: At each pulse heart demon pays one art's timer, the next in slot order, at 1 per second left; it fires this instant at its normal linh lực cost. Closes your seasons: see The Owed Wait.
new.second_home: any build that must have one slow art early

new.name: Both Hands
new.effect: While heart demon stands above 50 as a pulse begins, the pool pays two arts that pulse.

new.name: Cornered
new.effect: +50 points while your health share is below the enemy's.
new.second_home: any comeback build; used by The Herd-Child

new.name: Every Blow
new.effect: +0.3 heart demon per 1 % of maximum health lost to a hit, kept after the fight.
new.second_home: any capability #25 or Heart Demon's Blade build

new.name: The Owed Wait
new.effect: One season at the landing owed per heart demon spent. Each season paid returns 1 heart demon with decay off; each left unpaid costs 1 Dao heart.
new.second_home: any power paid in seasons, such as an oath or a sentence

new.name: Landing Ground
new.effect: +40 points on a place where you owe seasons. A ground tag, so a blind fight keeps it.
new.second_home: a hermit of a single place

new.name: Wait Here
new.effect: Qi hit, c_art 2.7, cost 0.04, 6 s. The enemy's art nearest to firing is pushed back 3 s.

new.name: The Last Ferry
new.effect: Body hit, c_art 6.3, cost 0.05, 20 s, guard enemy health below 40 %.

new.name: Ferry-Rope Sutra
new.effect: Main, Địa giai, Water. linh_luc_pct 20, khi_huyet_pct 15, attack_pct 15. Five arts, seals Cold Landing.

new.name: Cold Landing
new.effect: Sealed, Heart State, Water, outer, size 10. Notables Every Blow, then Both Hands with Already Waited as its capability.

new.name: Heart demon in a fight
new.effect: A fight can spend and raise heart demon, reported to Character Stats like vitality loss. Combat rules 2 and 14, Character Stats rule 8.

questions: A heart demon of 85 is a character the game expects to be in danger. Is a build that holds one on purpose wanted?
Should a quest offer the return of the one who left? It would end the build, and it may be the best story in it.
One season per point means a fair fight costs about 7.5 years. On a 1,000-year life is that the right price?
